system.description: God of law as Order itself, of oaths and trust; laws must be obeyed whether fair or not, and oath-breakers face his personal curse.
system.summary: God of law as Order itself, of oaths and trust; laws must be obeyed whether fair or not, and oath-breakers face his personal curse.
commandments: Master your own fear and instill it in your enemies.
Answer betrayal with force; trust until trust is broken and restore it only once repaid.
directives: Law serves the people and guides them through turmoil.
Bring lawbreakers to justice without committing crimes yourself.
Have an answer ready and make the world predictable.
Never bend the law; its fairness or unfairness must stay consistent.
Oaths are holy under his law and outrank any mortal statute.

cults.name: Judges
cults.summary: Harsh but fair jurists holding legal posts across many spheres, building a shared court network toward one universal legal code.

cults.name: Lynchmen
cults.summary: Uniformed vigilantes enforcing law in lawless places through fear, acting as judge and executioner.
